_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Done: Find company jobs and careers

description:
Best for: open jobs at named companies, such as "jobs at Stripe", "is Notion hiring designers?" or "remote backend jobs at Ramp and Linear". Covers careers pages on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable and SmartRecruiters; other companies come back as not_found.
Returns: per company, each job's title, locations, workplace type, salary when published, posting date, a short summary and the applyUrl. Call this first when you need a job's exact title or applyUrl for the other tools.
Input tips: send companies as the user says them or as careers page links, 1 to 5, such as {"companies": ["Stripe"], "keyword": "designer"}. Optional filters: keyword, location, remote, department, postedSince (YYYY-MM-DD), withSalary.
Not for: looking up people at a company, applying to a job, or companies on other systems (point the user to the company's own careers page).

companies.description: Company names as the user says them, or careers page links, 1 to 5, such as ["Stripe", "Hugging Face"].

keyword.description: The role to find, matched on the job title, such as "designer" or "backend engineer". "engineer" also finds Engineering and Solutions Engineer titles. A skill no title names, such as "rust", is matched on the posting text instead.

limit.description: Most jobs per company. Default 10, most 50: a larger value returns 50 with a message.

location.description: City, country name or ISO country code, such as "London" or "DE"

postedSince.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD, such as "2026-10-01"; keeps jobs posted on or after it

remote.description: true to keep only remote jobs

withSalary.description: true to keep only jobs that publish a salary

name: find_company_jobs

filters.description: The filters the list was cut to. When set, the board has other open jobs too.

matchedOn.description: title: every job's title names the keyword. text: no title did, and these jobs only mention it in the posting.

message.description: Why the list is empty or missing, and the next step: for not_found ask for the careers page link, for unavailable retry once later.

shown.description: How many jobs the list holds. Quote this count; do not count rows.

title: Find company jobs and careers
